Why people drive here

Most stores carry one box of couscous. We carry the one your mother used.

If you grew up with Algerian food, you know the difference. The right semolina grind. The biscuits from your school lunch. The spice blend that smells like your grandmother's kitchen.

Big grocery chains don't stock them. Mackmart brings them to Hilliard, so you can pick them up on a Tuesday night instead of waiting for a trip home.
